newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 26.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

On Tuesday media giant said it had entered an alliance with U.S.-based satellite broadcaster EchoStar Communications. The deal sees News Corp contribute satellites, cash and other assets of US$1 billion in return for a 50 percent stake in EchoStar.
Biscuit maker to start restocking shelves today after police say there was no longer a threat to food items from extortion threat against the group.
Petrol refining and building materials group due to report first half results. Pioneer jointly owns Australian Petroleum Pty ltd (AMPOL) with Caltex.
Petrol refiner/retailer due to report full year results.
Insurance group to report first half profit results. Analysts median forecast is for a net profit of A$85.7 million before abnormals and any transfer to ist disaster reserve.
